title: An installed project with no manifest is read as nothing to check: upgrade --from overwrites its edits at exit 0 and doctor passes
body:
FOUND 2026-09-24 by critic-shell's review of 0144 v1, and ruled into 0.1.8 by hv ("Fix now"). It is the same class as 0144, a false green in the manifest, the integrity record every install writes and doctor checks, through a path 0144 does not touch: the manifest is not unreadable, it is ABSENT.

WHAT HAPPENS, as the critic reported it (to be re-driven by the builder at the base before anything is built): in a project devbin is installed in (bin/.devbin/lib present) whose bin/.devbin/manifest.sha256 is missing, `bin/devbin upgrade --from <src>` treats every vendored file as unrecorded and overwrites it, a project's edits included, at exit 0. doctor then passes the next run, because the upgrade wrote a fresh manifest over the files it just replaced. Before the upgrade, doctor treats a missing manifest the way 0144 found for an unreadable one before its fix: it has no entries, so it checks nothing and says nothing that fails.

WHAT A FIX MUST DO:
- Say what an installed project with no manifest is: a project whose vendored files cannot be checked, and never a clean one. doctor FAILs it by name, with the remedy, and keeps running and counting (0120).
- upgrade refuses to overwrite vendored files it has no record of, and says why and what to do. The remedy must be one that exists, eg `--force` to accept replacing them unchecked, if upgrade has one, or a named re-install. The refusal happens before any write.
- vendor, and any other reader of the manifest's absence, reads it as unknown, never as level.
- An install into a project that has never had devbin is not this case: there is nothing vendored to protect. The builder names the test that tells the two apart (eg bin/.devbin/lib present) and drives both.
- MEASURE before shipping: every estate in the fleet has a manifest (read-only), so no estate turns red.
- Arms, each red first at the base with a control; mutants for each refusal and for the doctor verdict; pages doctor.md, upgrade.md and vendor.md.

vc's. It ships in 0.1.8, built on 0144.

## Resolution

Fixed at 7b84b24. Ships in 0.1.8.

- WHAT CHANGED. One test, manifest_missing, beside 0144's manifest_readable: installed (bin/.devbin/lib present) and no manifest file. A project devbin was never installed in is not it, and a first install goes through. Every reader decides: upgrade refuses, exit 1, before the source is looked for and before any write, naming both remedies, `upgrade --from <dir> --force` and a re-install with `install --into <project> --force`; --force replaces every vendored file, says so once the source is known to be a devbin, and writes a manifest true of the files. vendor refuses with and without --from. vendor_states returns 1, so seam_is_level fails closed. devbin_version_of reads it as `unknown`, so doctor fails devbin_version beside the manifest. doctor FAILs it as unchecked, runs on and counts, and names the --force remedies with their cost and the project by its path, never a plain upgrade. publish-upgrade says every file is replaced unchecked. MEASURED read-only before it shipped: an independent walk of the fleet roots found 41 bin/.devbin/lib directories, 40 with a manifest and one empty directory in an index mirror that nothing runs devbin in; no estate turns red.
- NOT CHANGED, ON THE RECORD. install --force over such an install copies every file and retires nothing, since nothing is recorded to retire; a file devbin has since stopped shipping is left, and doctor notes it as unowned. fleet finds installs by their manifest, so it cannot see one with none; fleet is devbin's own command, not vendored, and this is on vc's parked list.
- REVIEWS. critic-shell reviewed the code, then checked the arms. Code: no rule-pack finding, and three outside it, all taken; of two recommendations one taken and one answered. Arms: one warning, a refute that could never fail, taken, and four recommendations, all taken, each new assertion run red against the code it guards. vc's review: vc, 2026-09-25, approved on hv's "fix now" ruling of 2026-09-24, the patch and the evidence below.
- RED FIRST AND MUTANTS. Every arm red at 0144 v2b for its own reason, with a control, on a dirty tree and a clean commit alike; the doctor arms for 0144 and 0146 share one control that reads the source row's verdict before counting. 16 mutants, each against the arm it aims at: 16 of 16 killed.
- THE SUITE. All of tests/unit over the nine 0.1.8 changes stacked in landing order on b10dd41 (0139, 0128, 0133, 0130, 0142, 0143, 0144, 0146, 0147), on a clean checkout (head 308cf21), 2026-09-25 11:34:20Z to 12:09:20Z: 1907 of 1907 ok, 0 not ok, no gaps, its 5 skips the suite's declared ones. Main after the landing is byte-identical to that tree outside intent/.
